©2026 Recurly, Inc.

Recurly Engage

Customer engagement platform for subscription businesses

Connect product behavior, plan status, payment events and lifecycle milestones to personalized experiences across web, mobile and TV. Growth and product teams can build journeys in the low-code console, then connect prompts to subscription actions.

Get started

Reach each subscriber at the moment that matters

Customer engagement software becomes more useful when it understands the subscriber’s account as well as their behavior. Use plan state, trial timing, payment events and product usage to personalize in-app experiences. That context helps your team guide the next best action, from an upgrade to payment recovery.

Behavior tracking

When engagement changes, target at-risk subscribers with lifecycle actions that reflect their recent activity.

Payment moments

Guide subscribers to update a failed payment method inside the product, where they’re already signed in.

Upgrades and upsells

Invite engaged subscribers to move to a higher-tier plan or add a relevant product when their usage signals interest.

Trial flexibility

Use supported billing connectors to extend a trial or guide a prospective subscriber to the plan that fits their usage.

Meet the cancellation moment with a personalized path forward

When a subscriber chooses to cancel, use plan data and account context to address the frustration behind the decision. Offer a lower-priced plan when cost is the issue, or a pause when the timing is wrong. If a survey is part of the flow, the response can guide the next step.

On average, when Recurly helps save a monthly subscriber, they stay at least 6 more months.

Save offers matched to the account

Use plan, tenure, value and recent behavior to personalize the response, saving the strongest discounts for the groups that matter most.

More ways to stay

Offer a pause, lower-priced plan, discount or different package in the order that fits each audience.

Billing action updated in one click

Through supported connectors, an accepted offer can apply a coupon, pause service, switch plans or reactivate an account while updating the subscription record.

Test the full experience

Compare messaging, design, offers and billing actions against a control group, then apply what performs best.

How it works

From signal to action in four steps

Connect subscriber data

Bring account, billing and product behavior from your subscription management platform and other customer systems.

Add the tag or SDK

Use the lightweight JavaScript tag for web experiences or an SDK for mobile and TV apps. The tag initializes Engage, tracks interactions and powers secure, branded checkout flows.

Build and target experiences

Use the low-code console to choose the audience, moment, creative and action.

Measure revenue impact

Track saves, upgrades, recoveries and conversions by experience, then improve with experiments.

Engagement becomes revenue

10-40%

churn reduction

4X

Engage delivers on ROI

6 mo

LTV added for saved subscribers

8,600+

merchants served

Works with the subscription management platform you already use

Recurly Engage can run as a standalone platform, with documented connectors for Recurly, Stripe, Chargebee and Zuora. Your existing subscription management platform stays in place. Use the lightweight JavaScript tag for web experiences or SDKs for iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku and supported connected-TV environments.

Target the audiences and offers that retain more subscribers

Connect billing traits, product behavior, device data and custom attributes for granular segmentation. Segments update as subscriber data changes. Experiments let you compare messaging, design, actions or a control group against conversion goals.

Build personalized paywalls in the low-code builder

Create paywalls that adapt to each subscriber’s behavior and access level. Set complimentary views, choose how restricted content appears and match the experience to your brand. A/B testing helps your team refine the path from free access to paid subscription.

Grow revenue at every stage, with subscribers in control

Support the full subscriber lifecycle

Run acquisition, onboarding, feature adoption, upsell, retention and win-back experiences from one platform. Use exit intent to bring visitors back to checkout, then keep each journey connected to the subscriber’s history.

Give subscribers more control

Let subscribers accept an offer or update their subscription inside your product. Supported 1-Click Actions can apply a coupon, pause service, switch plans or reactivate an account.

Built for teams accountable for subscriber growth

Customer engagement and subscription retention software give growth, product, lifecycle marketing and CX teams a faster way to launch and improve in-app experiences.

Growth and lifecycle marketing

Launch acquisition, upsell, retention and win-back journeys in the low-code console.

Product

Give growth teams room to test lifecycle experiences while product focuses on the core experience.

Retention and CX

Offer plan flexibility and relevant save experiences inside the product.

Executives

Connect engagement experiments to realized revenue.

Customer engagement platform capabilities

Prompt types

Match your brand across banners, corner notifications, modals, interstitials, video and inline placements.

Lifecycle plays

Start with ready-to-use journeys for onboarding, feature adoption, payment guidance, upgrades, renewal and win-back.

Propensity modeling

Identify at-risk subscribers using behavioral engagement signals. Recurly Subscriptions customers can also incorporate billing and payment history for a richer model.

1-Click Actions

Let subscribers accept offers and update subscriptions inside your product through supported billing connectors.

Setup

Use the Recurly Engage tag for web or lightweight SDKs for web, mobile, TV and hybrid apps.

Frequently asked questions

Recurly Engage is a customer engagement platform for subscription businesses. It uses subscriber data and behavioral signals to power acquisition, onboarding, upgrades, retention and win-back experiences across web, mobile and TV.

Meet subscribers at the cancellation moment with a personalized option that addresses the reason they want to leave. Supported 1-Click Actions can apply the accepted offer directly to the subscription record.

Yes. Recurly Engage is available as a standalone platform, so you can keep your current subscription management platform. Documented connectors include Stripe, Chargebee and Zuora, along with Recurly. The team can review your setup and use cases to confirm the right fit.

Your team can build, target and test experiences in the low-code console. Initial implementation uses the JavaScript tag for web or an SDK for mobile and TV apps. After setup, business teams can manage routine changes directly.

Yes. Guide subscribers to update a failed payment method inside your product. For automated retries and broader failed-payment recovery, see Recurly Recover.

It combines product behavior with subscription state and billing actions. That gives teams customer retention software capabilities, including cancel-save flows and one-click plan changes, within the broader engagement platform.

Use experiments to compare messaging, designs, actions and an optional control group against conversion goals. Reporting connects outcomes such as saves and upgrades to each prompt.

Yes. Lightweight SDKs support web, iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku, React Native and compatible connected-TV environments.

Yes. Target former subscribers with relevant win-back experiences and let them resubscribe through supported 1-Click Actions.

A cancellation flow begins when a subscriber chooses to cancel. It can present a relevant option, such as a pause, plan change, temporary discount or support path, while keeping a clear route to complete cancellation.

Save offers present an alternative that addresses the reason a subscriber wants to leave. Someone concerned about price can receive a lower-priced plan, while someone who needs a break can choose a pause. Matching the response to the situation protects revenue while reserving stronger incentives for the right audiences.

Yes. Set complimentary access limits, choose how restricted content appears and match the paywall to your brand. The low-code builder and experiments help your team refine the experience and improve conversion.

A cancellation survey captures why a subscriber has chosen to leave. The response can guide a save offer, plan change, support path or feature recommendation, while giving your team a clearer view of recurring churn drivers.

Useful exit survey software connects feedback to an immediate response. Look for in-app surveys, granular audience targeting, response-based journeys and connections to your customer systems. Recurly Engage can use a selection to trigger a connector, API or website action.

Yes. Recurly Engage is the current name for the technology previously offered as Redfast. Recurly acquired Redfast in 2025, and some legacy technical references still use the earlier name.

Turn subscriber intent into the next best action

See how Recurly Engage connects customer data to timely in-app experiences across the subscriber lifecycle.

Get started

Payment moments

Guide subscribers to update a failed payment method inside the product, where they’re already signed in.

Upgrades and upsells
